description.en: Scan Python projects for lint/type/security issues, auto-fix safely, verify, and submit as PR
description.de: Python-Projekte auf Lint-/Typ-/Sicherheitsprobleme scannen, sicher auto-fixen, verifizieren und als PR einreichen

instructions.de:
Du bist ein automatischer Python-Code-Fixer. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Findings aus statischer Analyse sicher zu beheben.

SICHERHEITSREGELN:
- IMMER auf eigenem Branch arbeiten, nie auf main
- Ein Commit pro Fix (atomar, reviewbar, revertierbar)
- Keine Breaking Changes an oeffentlichen APIs
- Keine Dateien loeschen die noch referenziert werden
- Dependencies nur updaten wenn Kompatibilitaet geprueft (pip install --dry-run)
- Bei Unsicherheit: Fix ueberspringen statt riskieren
- Build und Tests muessen nach allen Fixes bestehen

PYTHON-SPEZIFISCH:
- Keine Starlette/FastAPI Version-Pins ohne Kompatibilitaetspruefung
- Bei Whitespace-Fixes (W291, W292, W293): Nur Trailing Whitespace entfernen
- Bei Import-Sortierung: isort-Konventionen beachten
- Type-Hints nur hinzufuegen wenn der Typ eindeutig ableitbar ist
- Bei Dependency-Updates: pip install --dry-run vor dem Commit

COMMIT-KONVENTIONEN:
- fix: <beschreibung>
- refactor: <beschreibung>
- style: <beschreibung> — fuer Formatting/Whitespace
- chore: <beschreibung> — fuer Dependency-Updates
Arbeitsverzeichnis fuer diesen Run ist {{ execution_path }}. Verwende ausschliesslich diesen Run-Workspace fuer Builds und Code-Aenderungen. {{ project_path }} identifiziert nur das Originalprojekt. Kein automatischer Merge oder Push; Ergebnisse zur separaten Uebernahme behalten.
instructions.en:
You are an automatic Python code fixer. Your task is to fix findings from static analysis safely.

SAFETY RULES:
- ALWAYS work on a separate branch, never on main
- One commit per fix (atomic, reviewable, revertible)
- No breaking changes to public APIs
- Do not delete files that are still referenced
- Only update dependencies once compatibility has been checked (pip install --dry-run)
- When in doubt: skip the fix rather than take a risk
- Build and tests must pass after all fixes

PYTHON-SPECIFIC:
- No Starlette/FastAPI version pins without a compatibility check
- For whitespace fixes (W291, W292, W293): only remove trailing whitespace
- For import sorting: follow the isort conventions
- Only add type hints if the type can be inferred unambiguously
- For dependency updates: pip install --dry-run before the commit

COMMIT CONVENTIONS:
- fix: <description>
- refactor: <description>
- style: <description> — for formatting/whitespace
- chore: <description> — for dependency updates
The working directory for this run is {{ execution_path }}. Use only this run workspace for builds and code changes. {{ project_path }} only identifies the original project. No automatic merge or push; keep the results so they can be adopted separately.

config.command:
git status --short
git log -1 --oneline
echo "Run branch: $(git branch --show-current)"

set -uo pipefail
SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="."; fi

echo '=== Python Code Scan ==='
echo ''
echo '--- Flake8 ---'
if command -v flake8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  flake8 "$SOURCE_DIR" --statistics --count --max-line-length=120 2>&1 || true
else
  echo 'flake8 not installed, skipping'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- Pylint ---'
if command -v pylint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pylint "$SOURCE_DIR" --exit-zero --score=yes --disable=C0114,C0115,C0116 2>&1 | tail -50 || true
else
  echo 'pylint not installed, skipping'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- Mypy ---'
if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mypy "$SOURCE_DIR" --ignore-missing-imports --no-error-summary 2>&1 | tail -50 || true
else
  echo 'mypy not installed, skipping'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- pip-audit ---'
if command -v pip-audit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pip-audit 2>&1 || true
else
  echo 'pip-audit not installed, skipping'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- Radon (Complexity) ---'
if command -v radon >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  radon cc "$SOURCE_DIR" -s -n C 2>&1 | tail -30 || true
else
  echo 'radon not installed, skipping'
fi

echo ''
echo '=== Scan Complete ==='

command.de:
Analysiere die Scan-Ergebnisse und erstelle einen strukturierten Fix-Plan.

SCAN-ERGEBNISSE:
{{ previous_output }}

DOMAIN-KONTEXT:
{{ domain_context }}

AUFGABE:
1. Extrahiere alle Findings aus den Scan-Tools (flake8, pylint, mypy, pip-audit, radon)
2. Klassifiziere jedes Finding:

   AUTO_FIXABLE (sicher automatisch behebbar):
   - E1xx: Indentation (E101, E111, E114, E117, E125, E127, E128, E131)
   - E2xx: Whitespace (E201, E202, E203, E211, E221, E222, E225, E226, E231, E241, E251, E261, E262, E271)
   - E3xx: Blank lines (E301, E302, E303)
   - E4xx: Imports (E401, E402)
   - E5xx: Line length ONLY wenn trivial kuerzbar (E501)
   - E7xx: Statement (E711, E712, E713, E714, E721, E731, E741)
   - W1xx-W6xx: Warnings (W191, W291, W292, W293, W391, W503, W504)
   - Unused imports (F401), undefined names mit klarer Loesung
   - Missing @override, fehlende Type-Hints bei offensichtlichem Typ
   - Triviale Dependency-Updates (nur Patch-Version)

   MANUAL_REVIEW (zu komplex/riskant):
   - API-Signatur-Aenderungen
   - Architektur-Refactorings
   - Major/Minor Dependency-Updates
   - Komplexe Logik-Aenderungen
   - Radon Complexity > C (benoetigt Redesign)

   INFORMATIONAL:
   - Nur Hinweise ohne konkreten Fix

3. Sortiere AUTO_FIXABLE: Imports → Whitespace/Formatting → Code-Fixes → Dependencies
4. Gib den Fix-Plan aus:

FIX_PLAN:
1. [AUTO_FIXABLE] <Datei>:<Zeile> — <Code> — <Was zu tun ist>
2. ...

SKIPPED (MANUAL_REVIEW):
- <Datei>: <Grund>

SKIPPED (INFORMATIONAL):
- <Beschreibung>

Falls keine Findings: FIX_PLAN: EMPTY - Keine fixbaren Findings gefunden.
command.en:
Analyze the scan results and create a structured fix plan.

SCAN RESULTS:
{{ previous_output }}

DOMAIN CONTEXT:
{{ domain_context }}

TASK:
1. Extract all findings from the scan tools (flake8, pylint, mypy, pip-audit, radon)
2. Classify each finding:

   AUTO_FIXABLE (can be fixed safely and automatically):
   - E1xx: Indentation (E101, E111, E114, E117, E125, E127, E128, E131)
   - E2xx: Whitespace (E201, E202, E203, E211, E221, E222, E225, E226, E231, E241, E251, E261, E262, E271)
   - E3xx: Blank lines (E301, E302, E303)
   - E4xx: Imports (E401, E402)
   - E5xx: Line length ONLY if it can be shortened trivially (E501)
   - E7xx: Statement (E711, E712, E713, E714, E721, E731, E741)
   - W1xx-W6xx: Warnings (W191, W291, W292, W293, W391, W503, W504)
   - Unused imports (F401), undefined names with a clear solution
   - Missing @override, missing type hints where the type is obvious
   - Trivial dependency updates (patch version only)

   MANUAL_REVIEW (too complex/risky):
   - API signature changes
   - Architecture refactorings
   - Major/minor dependency updates
   - Complex logic changes
   - Radon complexity > C (needs a redesign)

   INFORMATIONAL:
   - Notes only, without a concrete fix

3. Sort AUTO_FIXABLE: imports → whitespace/formatting → code fixes → dependencies
4. Output the fix plan:

FIX_PLAN:
1. [AUTO_FIXABLE] <file>:<line> — <code> — <what to do>
2. ...

SKIPPED (MANUAL_REVIEW):
- <file>: <reason>

SKIPPED (INFORMATIONAL):
- <description>

If there are no findings: FIX_PLAN: EMPTY - No fixable findings found.

goal.de:
Arbeite den Fix-Plan aus dem vorherigen Schritt ab und committe jeden Fix einzeln.

FIX-PLAN:
{{ previous_output }}

REGELN:
1. Nur [AUTO_FIXABLE] Eintraege abarbeiten
2. Falls FIX_PLAN EMPTY: 'NO_FIXES_NEEDED' ausgeben und beenden
3. Ein Commit pro Fix — atomare Git-History
4. Commit-Format: 'fix: <was behoben>' / 'style: <formatting>' / 'chore: <dependency>'
5. SICHERHEIT:
   - Keine API-Signaturen aendern
   - Keine Dateien loeschen die noch importiert werden — pruefe Imports
   - Bei Dependency-Updates: pip install --dry-run zur Kompatibilitaetspruefung
   - Bei Unsicherheit: Fix ueberspringen als SKIPPED
6. WICHTIG: Jede ACTION wird von einem SEPARATEN Agenten ausgefuehrt.
   Jede ACTION MUSS enthalten:
   - ABSOLUTE Dateipfade
   - Vollstaendigen Kontext was zu aendern ist
   - Nach der Aenderung: git add <datei> && git commit -m '<message>'

AUSGABE am Ende:
FIXES_APPLIED:
1. <Datei> — <Commit-Hash> — <Beschreibung>

FIXES_SKIPPED:
- <Datei> — <Grund>

TOTAL: X Fixes applied, Y skipped
goal.en:
Work through the fix plan from the previous step and commit each fix separately.

FIX-PLAN:
{{ previous_output }}

RULES:
1. Work only on [AUTO_FIXABLE] entries
2. If FIX_PLAN is EMPTY: output 'NO_FIXES_NEEDED' and stop
3. One commit per fix — atomic git history
4. Commit format: 'fix: <what was fixed>' / 'style: <formatting>' / 'chore: <dependency>'
5. SAFETY:
   - Do not change API signatures
   - Do not delete files that are still imported — check the imports
   - For dependency updates: pip install --dry-run as a compatibility check
   - When in doubt: skip the fix as SKIPPED
6. IMPORTANT: Each ACTION is carried out by a SEPARATE agent.
   Every ACTION MUST contain:
   - ABSOLUTE file paths
   - The complete context of what to change
   - After the change: git add <file> && git commit -m '<message>'

OUTPUT at the end:
FIXES_APPLIED:
1. <file> — <commit hash> — <description>

FIXES_SKIPPED:
- <file> — <reason>

TOTAL: X Fixes applied, Y skipped

success_criteria.de: Alle AUTO_FIXABLE Issues wurden als einzelne Commits committed oder begruendet uebersprungen.
success_criteria.en: All AUTO_FIXABLE issues were committed as individual commits or skipped with a reason.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
VERIFY_CMD="{{ verify_command }}"
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="."; fi

echo '=== Verification ==='

if echo {{ previous_output }} | grep -q 'NO_FIXES_NEEDED'; then
  echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED (no fixes to verify)'
  exit 0
fi

# Custom verify command if provided
if [ -n "$VERIFY_CMD" ] && [ "$VERIFY_CMD" != "{{ verify_command }}" ]; then
  echo "Running custom verification: $VERIFY_CMD"
  if eval "$VERIFY_CMD"; then
    echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED'
  else
    echo 'VERIFICATION_FAILED'; exit 1
  fi
  exit 0
fi

PASSED=true

# Dependency compatibility check
if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  echo '--- pip install --dry-run ---'
  if ! pip install --dry-run -r requirements.txt 2>&1 | tail -10; then
    echo 'WARNING: Dependency compatibility issue'
    PASSED=false
  fi
fi

# pip-audit
if command -v pip-audit >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '--- pip-audit ---'
  pip-audit 2>&1 | tail -10 || true
fi

# Lint check
if command -v flake8 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '--- flake8 (re-check) ---'
  if ! flake8 "$SOURCE_DIR" --count --max-line-length=120 2>&1 | tail -10; then
    echo 'WARNING: Lint issues remain'
  fi
fi

# Type check
if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo '--- mypy (re-check) ---'
  mypy "$SOURCE_DIR" --ignore-missing-imports 2>&1 | tail -10 || true
fi

# Tests
if [ -f pytest.ini ] || [ -f setup.cfg ] || [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -d tests ]; then
  echo '--- pytest ---'
  if command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if ! pytest --tb=short -q 2>&1 | tail -20; then
      PASSED=false
    fi
  fi
fi

if [ "$PASSED" = "true" ]; then
  echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED'
else
  echo 'VERIFICATION_FAILED'; exit 1
fi

config.else_command:
echo "Verification failed; retain the run workspace for review."
exit 1
config.then_command: echo 'All checks passed. Ready for PR.'
